mentions.name: DSC
mentions.description: A tensor library written from scratch in C++ with a PyTorch-like API that runs on both CPU and GPU (AMD and NVIDIA) and is capable of running LLMs like Qwen. A native profiler to trace CPU and GPU kernels is being implemented, with the goal of being competitive with PyTorch eager.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on DSC, a tensor library I wrote from scratch in C++ with a PyTorch-like API.
